title: WaitForSignal
body:
Gabriel: Both of you... I want you to plant charges across the bridge to draw the guards out. Wait for my signal.
<<signal>>
[Gabriel signals]
Let's roll.

title: Crash
body: Explosions reverberate across the bridge. Officers rush to investigate.

title: GoInside
body: Gabriel: NOW! Follow the map to the main chamber!

title: EveryoneClear
body: Gabriel: East is behind us, but job's not done.

title: EastFalls
body: DECA-East falls. The four head toward West.

title: ToWest
body:
Gabriel: Straight to West. Same plan. 
[The four disappear into the night and head to DECA-WEST]
